entry.title: Council releases 13 CSA2 documents
entry.summary: 1 compromise text, 1 progress report, 11 notes. Listed as not public since 25 Sep 2026; now public in the register. The released papers include Member States' comments on the certification rules (Articles 71-97) and the Presidency's second compromise text on Title III: the basis for reading the third compromise text when it is published.
